dedupe_keys.name: statistics south africa census dissemination platform and its json api with household access to piped water main water source toilet facility refuse disposal energy for lighting and cooking and dwelling type for censuses 1996 to 2022 by national province district municipality and main place

description: Statistics South Africa (Stats SA) disseminates results of Census 2022 and the earlier 2011, 2001 and 1996 censuses through a web platform that draws on a public JSON API. The API returns household counts and percentages by category for topics that describe services: access to piped water, main water source, toilet facility, refuse disposal, energy for lighting and cooking, dwelling type, tenure and household goods, for the nation, provinces and districts, and the platform also offers municipalities and main places. In Census 2022, 10,638,247 households had piped water inside the dwelling, 4,043,778 in the yard and 1,559,558 had no access to piped water; 16,882,396 households (94.7 percent) used mains electricity for lighting. Format and access: free JSON without a key; the platform itself needs JavaScript. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: the API is undocumented, its address and parameters were read from the platform script and may change, some topic and level combinations, including internet access, returned empty lists, and www.statssa.gov.za itself sat behind a bot check. Simulation uses: district counts of households without piped water or mains electricity for service backlogs and exposure. Related records: the Kenya 2019 census amenities and the Tanzania 2022 building census.

schema_summary: Report endpoints api/Ds{Topic}/getDs{Topic}Report/{timeSeriesId}/{geoLevelId}/{geoLevelValue}; timeSeriesId 1 = Census 2022, 2 = 2011, 4 = 2001, 5 = 1996; geoLevelId 1 National, 2 Province (provinceId), 3 Municipality, 4 Main place, 5 District (MDB code). Each row: census, geography, category label, count and percentage. Topics include AccessToPipedWaters, MainSourceOfWaters, MainToiletFacilitys, RefuseDisposals, EnergyForLightings, EnergyForCookings, AccessToInternets, TypeOfMainDwellings, TenureStatuses, HouseholdGoods and AgriculturalActivities
